parameters.text:
=You are a strict document data-extraction engine for an accounting firm. You must respond with ONLY a valid JSON object. No explanations, no preamble, no markdown code fences. Your entire response must start with { and end with }.

Classify and extract data from this document text: {{ $json.text }}

First decide Document_Type: one of "PO", "Invoice", "Receipt", or "Other" (use "Other" if it doesn't clearly match any of the first three).

Then extract:
- Vendor: the company ISSUING the document and being paid. It is usually the name/logo/contact block at the top-left or top of the page (the biller). Also look near "Vendor", "Supplier", "From", "Seller", "Pay to", or "Remit to".
- Client_Name: the customer who is BEING BILLED and will pay. Take it ONLY from a labelled field such as "Bill To", "Billed To", "Invoice To", "Customer", "Client", "Sold To", "Paid By", "To", or "Ship To", using the name written next to or under that label. NEVER use the name from the top-left/header block (that is the Vendor) as Client_Name. If the labelled field is missing, empty, or says "Unknown", "N/A", "-" or similar, return "" for Client_Name; do not guess and do not copy the Vendor.
- Document_Number: PO number, invoice number, or receipt number, whichever applies
- Date: the document date
- Due_Date: if present (common on invoices)
- Email: any email address found in the vendor/supplier block
- Sub_Total, Tax, Shipping_Fee, Discount, Grand_Total
- Line_Items: array of {Description, Qty, Price, Total}

Return ONLY this exact JSON structure:
{
  "Document_Type": "",
  "Vendor": "",
  "Client_Name": "",
  "Document_Number": "",
  "Date": "",
  "Due_Date": "",
  "Email": "",
  "Sub_Total": "",
  "Tax": "",
  "Shipping_Fee": "",
  "Discount": "",
  "Grand_Total": "",
  "Line_Items": [ { "Description": "", "Qty": 0, "Price": "", "Total": "" } ]
}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ { model: 'llava', stream: false, prompt: 'You are a strict document data-extraction engine for an accounting firm. Look at this document image. Respond with ONLY a valid JSON object, no explanations, no markdown fences.

Document_Type: one of "PO", "Invoice", "Receipt", or "Other".
Vendor: the company ISSUING the document and being paid, usually the name/logo block at the top-left (the biller).
Client_Name: the customer being billed, taken ONLY from a labelled field such as "Bill To", "Billed To", "Invoice To", "Customer", "Client", "Sold To", "Paid By" or "To". NEVER use the top-left/header company name. If that field is missing, empty or says "Unknown", return "".
Also extract Document_Number, Date, Due_Date, Email (from the vendor block), Sub_Total, Tax, Shipping_Fee, Discount, Grand_Total, and Line_Items.

Return exactly: {"Document_Type":"","Vendor":"","Client_Name":"","Document_Number":"","Date":"","Due_Date":"","Email":"","Sub_Total":"","Tax":"","Shipping_Fee":"","Discount":"","Grand_Total":"","Line_Items":[{"Description":"","Qty":0,"Price":"","Total":""}]}', images: [$json.data] } }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'unsupported', message: 'Only PDF and image files are supported.' } }}

parameters.text: =:question: Document could not be classified as PO/Invoice/Receipt: {{ $json.document_number }} — please review manually.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'unclassified', message: 'Document logged for manual review.' } }}
